_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Re-read live at 13:22 ET from the broker and unchanged for the fifth read running: 128.90 total, all of it cash, nothing unsettled, so deployable is the full balance. No equity or option positions are open, which is why the fourth mid-session run also had no exit to enforce.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Dead, and the one hour that argued otherwise has been taken back. AMD is bid 485.92 at 13:22 ET against a 518.58 official close, about -6.3%, which gives up most of the bounce to 488.79 read at 12:22 and puts the name back between the 486.55 of 10:22 and the 482.06 low. Last hour this board recorded a bounce and said plainly that a bounce inside a 5.7% gap is a less-bad reaction rather than a strong one; the useful thing about writing that down is that no flag has to move now that the bounce has faded. The full sequence is 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92 - a name chopping below a gap, not repairing one.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader is back to -6.3% having given up its bounce. There is no upside chain to find a laggard in - as of this hour there is no upside anywhere on the list, which is the cleanest form this condition has failed in all day. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 31.28, about -1.3%.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Still the one live catalyst on the list, and still the one entry the rulebook explicitly forbids today. UPST reported 8/4 after the bell and is bid 31.26 at 13:22 ET against a 30.32 close, about +3.1%. The intraday sequence now runs 33.81 after-hours, 32.23 open, 32.36, 32.05, 31.63, 31.26 - five consecutive lower reads, and the reaction day now sits 0.97 below its own open bid. The give-back strengthens the case for the 8/6-8/7 pullback setup and weakens nothing about the reason not to touch it today: a spike leaking through its own session is still the reaction day, and buying it late is still buying it.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: The branch the open resolved to and the position the account is still in four hours later. This is the first read today with no green print on the board at all: OKLO's +0.3% has flipped to -0.4%, so all nine candidates are red, and four of the nine report tonight. Every hour has now been checked against the levels and every hour has had none to check, because nothing is open. A one-position account has no way to be wrong cheaply here, and deployable cash keeps for a setup that fits.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-05 13:22 ET, live session bids. The Last column is the official 8/4 settled close.
